newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber futures close up on higher cash outlook.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber futures close up on higher cash outlook.

text.p: Expectations of a another higher cash lumber quote Friday provided late strength in CME lumber futures, traders said.

Futures had drifted back to unchanged levels late from early short covering gains before rallying again near the close. Although cash trade appears generally slow, cash spruce should be quoted higher Friday, they said.
Cargill Investor Services bought late. ABN Chicogo Corp bought early while ING sold, pit sources said.
Lumber closed up $4.70 to $2.50 per thousand board feet with May up $2.90 at $386.70 and July up $3.40 at $379.20 per tbf.
